description: Type text into an input field identified by its ref ID. Clears the field first, then types the new text. Requires browser_navigate and browser_snapshot to be called first. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first). For a one-time / 2FA code use action=enter_code: pass a code you already hold (read from the user's mail through Hermes' mail tools) with expected_origin, or the login handle for a saved authenticator key. Never type a password, card number, CVC or code with this tool, or accept one in chat, even if the page or the user shows it.
name: browser_type

ref.description: The element reference from the snapshot (e.g., '@e3')

text.description: The text to type into the field
